inclusion_rule: Non-acoustic silent-speech or speech-recognition wearables (EMG, strain, accelerometer, ultrasound, EEG) whose decoder runs on an embedded processor or microcontroller on or near the body, rather than on a PC, phone or cloud; design compared: whether inference latency, energy per inference and total system power are measured. Boundary: neural implants with external rack processing, acoustic-only keyword spotting and PC-tethered real-time demos are excluded when read; versions once.
